items.title: Is starting a personal blog still worth it in the age of AI?
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN — I’ve wanted to start a personal blog for a few years, but I keep hesitating. I write a lot privately (notes, mini-essays, thinking-through problems). Paul Graham’s idea that essays are a way to learn really resonates with me. But I rarely publish anything beyond occasional LinkedIn posts. My blockers: •“Nobody needs this” / “It’s not original” •“AI can explain most topics better than I can” •A bit of fear: shipping something that feels naive or low-signal At the same time, I read a lot of personal blogs + LinkedIn and I do get real value from them — mostly from perspective, lived experience, and clear thinking, not novelty. items.title: Cognitive Offloading in the Era of AI
items.raw_excerpt: We keep moving thinking out of our heads and into tools. Paper caught memories. Calculators captured arithmetic. AI now catches recall, drafting, and pattern finding. The risk is mushy judgment; the reward is shipping faster with fewer mistakes. The difference is in how you steer.

title_i18n.en: Cognitive Offloading in the Era of AI
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能时代的认知卸载
title_i18n.es: Descarga Cognitiva en la Era de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: We keep moving thinking out of our heads and into tools. Paper caught memories. Calculators captured arithmetic. AI now catches recall, drafting, and pattern finding. The risk is mushy judgment; the reward is shipping faster with fewer mistakes. The difference is in how you steer.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们将思考从头脑移至工具。纸张承载记忆，计算器捕捉算术，如今人工智能则负责回忆、草拟与模式识别。风险在于判断力钝化，回报则是高效交付。
excerpt_i18n.es: Seguimos trasladando el pensamiento de nuestras cabezas a las herramientas. El papel atrapó los recuerdos. Las calculadoras capturaron la aritmética. La IA ahora atrapa el recuerdo, la redacción y la detección de patrones. El riesgo es un juicio difuso; la recompensa es la entrega rápida.
